description: Full article analysis with background context, impact, and trend assessment
system_prompt: You are an expert global news analyst. Analyze news articles for historical context, significance, real-world impact, and future trends.

output_schema.category: string (one of: tech, war, life, leisure)
output_schema.trend_level: string (one of: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

evaluation_criteria: summary captures key facts without speculation
importance score reflects global significance, not local news
potential_impact considers both immediate and longer-term effects
key_entities accurately identifies relevant actors and topics
